description: This file defines the EmployeeAttachment entity class for the OrangeHRM system. It maps to the database table 'hs_hr_emp_attachment' and includes properties and methods related to employee attachments such as files or documents, including metadata like description, filename, size, attachment data, and associated employee details.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's attachment, including metadata and the actual attachment data, with ORM mapping annotations for database persistence.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this attachment.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee object with this attachment.

methods.name: getAttachId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: setAttachId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the attachment.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the attachment.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the attachment.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename for the attachment.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment in bytes.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the attachment.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the attachment data (blob or resource).

methods.name: setAttachment
methods.description: Sets the attachment data.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type or file type of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type or file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the screen context for the attachment.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the screen context for the attachment, validates allowed values.

methods.name: getAttachedBy
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: setAttachedBy
methods.description: Sets the ID of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedByName
methods.description: Returns the name of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: setAttachedByName
methods.description: Sets the name of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedTime
methods.description: Returns the datetime when the attachment was added.

methods.name: setAttachedTime
methods.description: Sets the datetime when the attachment was added.
